sources.snippet: The model employs a hybrid Latent Mixture-of-Experts (LatentMoE) architecture, utilizing interleaved Mamba-2 and MoE layers, along with select Attention layers. The Lightning 3.5 model is released alongside a number of speculative decoding methods for faster text generation. The model has 3B active parameters and 30B parameters in total.

sources.snippet: Get Started with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning # Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a compact, text-only, reasoning-capable model in the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning family.
